pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal and sub-rectangular dark brown regions with softened edge gradients; spatial area of patches is relatively consistent across the visible flank, becoming smaller and more condensed toward the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan pathways forming a tessellated grid; junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial; pixel thickness remains largely uniform across the mid-flank with slight narrowing at the dorsal-to-lateral transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette of the mane along the upper neck ridge against the blurred background foliage.

other_distinctive_markers: Partial occlusion of the anterior lower neck and shoulder region by foreground vegetation featuring yellow and green leaves.
